messages:
chloe: FYI promo for v2.14.0 blocked — canary CI failed at cache-validate (503) then artifact fetch 404. release window ~2h.

deploy-bot: promo_state=HALTED last_error="artifact fetch 404 after cache-validate 503" retries=3

jon: any builder logs?

chloe: pasted snippet: cache-validate GET /validate/sha256:abc123 -> 503; fetch /artifacts/v2.14.0/layer-3.tar.gz -> 404

maya: sounds like cache edge or auth rotation; 404 hints index mismatch or unfinished upload.

sre-oncall: cache-usw2 showing 5xx spikes, ops rotating nodes (ETA 30-45m).

release-manager: propose pinning prod to last-good v2.13.7 and manual-promote that artifact to unblock. postpone v2.14.0 to next change window.

jon: will run smoke against v2.13.7, open PR to update release pin, then request manual promote.

(10m)

jon: smoke passed on v2.13.7. PR infra/rollout/manifest#4572 ready.

release-manager: +1 approving manual promote.

deploy-bot: manual promote initiated -> prod. rollout 25%->100% over 12m. status SUCCESS.

chloe: updating release notes and filing incident for cache + artifact index race. follow-ups: add pre-validate upload step and retries on cache 5xx. thread closing.
